source: RFC 7638 §3.4 over the RFC 8037 Appendix A.6 key
description: SHA-512 JWK Thumbprint of Bob's X25519 public key from RFC 8037 A.6 (RFC 7748 §6.1); no RFC prints it: SHA-512 over the hand-built RFC 7638 §3.3 hash input with node:crypto (Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8), conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/thumbprints.mjs; the URI carries the IANA name sha-512 (RFC 9278 §3, §4)
